notes: Customer: omnichannel contact center provider focused on BPO and in-house CX teams.
Primary ask: streaming agent assist with real-time suggestions (inline, 1–2 token suggestion latency goal), and tool-calling support (CRM update + disposition + DB lookup hooks).
Latency SLOs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms during steady state; must handle 3k concurrent active agents with spiky bursts to 6k.

Quality & guardrails: deterministic guardrails for policy phrases (no legal advice), hallucination mitigation via retrieval-augmented prompts and token-level verifier. Need support for function/tool calling with strong audit trail.
Compliance: SOC2 required, ISO27001 desirable, strict EU data residency for several accounts, SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning required.
Quote from CTO on 2024-11-12 call: "We need predictable latency at scale — we can’t have suggestion lag during peak hours."
Current stack: Talkdesk CTI, Snowflake for transcripts, internal user profile store, Postgres for context. Wants Redwood to integrate via VPC peering and to run a dedicated pool for POC.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for predictability; primary metric for procurement is cost per assisted resolution and reduction in handle time.

POC size: 100 agents live for 3 weeks, A/B against current baseline. Success criteria: 10% relative increase in first-contact resolution (FCR) or 15% decrease in average handle time (AHT), and p95 inference latency <=120ms under simulated peak.
Requested deliverables: dedicated latency/cost profile, kernel/quantization recommendation for their workload, ops playbook for fallbacks and graceful degradation.
Integration note: will require connector work for our tool-calling APIs (updateTicket, applyDisposition) — SE estimate: 2 sprints.
Security review: customer sent security questionnaire on 2024-11-20; legal returned with additional data residency asks on 2024-11-27.
Talked to Head of Platform (Maria Soto) — wants model explainability hooks in console and per-request audit id for ticket history linkage.
Sales motion: PLG-originated; heavy engineering evaluation. Procurement team likely to engage in January if POC successful.
Risks: They operate in regulated finance vertical for several clients — if Redwood can’t provide EU-residency + audit log retention SLA, deal will stall.
Next immediate action: SE to provision dedicated test pool + run synthetic spike tests (Marco Li).
